summary_markdown:
The conversation clarified the methodology for calculating traffic and unique visitors (uniques) within a cluster, specifically comparing 'Park Analytics' data to 'Traffic Page' data. It was established that while total traffic counts should be consistent across both systems (counting one device only once per visit), the calculation of uniques and dwell time differs significantly between the two platforms.

Regarding session duration for Park Analytics, the required period is 2 hours for Transport Hubs and 8 hours for all other locations.

A separate issue regarding data visibility was discussed. A feature (color and race) that was missing on the production environment was eventually made visible after [p1] performed a hard refresh (Cmd+Shift+R).
decisions: Total traffic counts in Park Analytics should count one device only once per visit, matching the cluster logic.
Uniques and dwell time calculations differ between Park Analytics and Traffic Page.
The session duration for Park Analytics is 2 hours for Transport Hubs and 8 hours otherwise.
